notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.37.0.

Breaks and admin check-in
- Staff app: "Request a break" with minutes. After the owner approves, the employee is on break; when back they press "I am back" and the owner confirms. Time over the approved minutes is added to the late time and cut from pay.
- Settings: breaks on/off and the longest break.
- Admin: new "✔ Check in" button on the Today board for anyone with no check-in (phone dead / no phone), with a reason; late cut applies from the time you enter.
